title: Senior Quality Manager / Director of Quality
text:
**Senior Quality Manager / Director of Quality**

**Location:** Lakewood, Ohio 
**Company:** Ferry Cap & Set Screw Company 
**Employment Type:** Full Time 
**Reports To:** President

**About Ferry Cap**

Ferry Cap & Set Screw Company is a long-established American manufacturer of engineered fasteners and specialty metal components serving demanding industrial and power generation applications. As we invest in our people, equipment, and operating systems, we are seeking a senior quality leader who can help strengthen our processes and build a companywide culture of quality.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Quality Manager / Director of Quality will lead Ferry Cap’s quality organization and serve as a key member of the company’s leadership team.

This is a hands on leadership position for someone with strong experience in metallurgy, metal transformation, manufacturing processes, and heat treatment. The successful candidate will work closely with operations, engineering, maintenance, supply chain, and customers to improve process control, solve technical problems, and ensure consistent product quality.

The right leader will view quality as an operating partnership, not simply an inspection function. This individual must be comfortable working on the production floor, engaging directly with employees, and helping build quality into every stage of the manufacturing process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all quality assurance, quality control, laboratory, inspection, and quality systems activities.
* Partner directly with operations to establish a culture in which safety, delivery, quality, and cost are shared responsibilities.
* Provide technical leadership related to metallurgy, raw materials, metal forming, metal transformation, machining, threading, and heat treatment.
* Oversee metallurgical testing and analysis, including hardness, microstructure, case depth, decarburization, mechanical properties, material certification, and failure analysis.
* Evaluate and improve heat treatment processes, including furnace controls, quenching, tempering, process consistency, and product conformance.
* Strengthen incoming, in process, and final inspection systems to ensure product requirements are consistently achieved.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action activities involving internal defects, customer complaints, supplier issues, and process failures.
* Use structured problem solving methods such as 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and MSA.
* Maintain and continuously improve the company’s quality management system, documentation, procedures, work instructions, and audit processes.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, industry standards, specifications, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Lead customer audits, supplier audits, internal audits, and customer quality reviews.
* Build strong working relationships with customer quality and engineering teams.
* Develop meaningful quality metrics, including first pass yield, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality, customer complaints, corrective action effectiveness, and supplier performance.
* Improve material traceability and process control throughout the manufacturing operation.
* Lead supplier quality development and ensure purchased materials and outside processes meet Ferry Cap requirements.
* Develop, coach, and hold accountable the quality team while strengthening quality knowledge throughout the organization.
* Support new product introduction, process changes, capital projects, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Establish clear containment, escalation, and corrective action processes when quality concerns arise.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant quality leadership experience in a metal manufacturing environment.
* Strong practical knowledge of metallurgy, material properties, metal transformation, and heat treatment.
* Experience with manufacturing processes such as cold forming, forging, machining, threading, rolling, or similar metalworking operations.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose metallurgical and manufacturing process failures.
* Experience leading quality systems, customer audits, corrective actions, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong working knowledge of dimensional inspection, mechanical testing, metallurgical testing, calibration, and measurement systems.
* Experience using quality tools such as PFMEA, control plans, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis.
* Proven ability to work collaboratively with operations and engineering teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem solving skills.
* Willingness to spend significant time on the manufacturing floor and become personally involved in resolving issues.
* Bachelor’s degree in metallurgy, materials science, engineering, manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant manufacturing experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ten or more years of progressive quality experience, including at least five years in a leadership role.
* Experience with engineered fasteners, high strength components, critical industrial products, or power generation applications.
* Experience with ISO based quality management systems and customer specific quality requirements.
* Experience working with commercial heat treat suppliers and internal heat treatment operations.
* ASQ certification, Six Sigma certification, or formal Lean manufacturing training.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.

**Leadership Profile**

The successful candidate will be:

* Hands on and comfortable working directly with production employees.
* Collaborative and capable of building trust across departments.
* Technically strong, practical, and decisive.
* Focused on preventing defects instead of relying on inspection to find them.
* Comfortable challenging existing practices while respecting Ferry Cap’s people and history.
* Able to balance customer requirements with operational realities.
* Committed to accountability, continuous improvement, and developing others.

**Why Join Ferry Cap**

This position offers the opportunity to play a major role in the continued transformation and growth of a historic American manufacturing company. The Senior Quality Manager / Director of Quality will have direct access to company leadership, meaningful influence over operations, and the opportunity to build a quality culture that supports Ferry Cap’s customers, employees, and long term success.

Ferry Cap & Set Screw Company is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
